long_biography.plain_text:
Foley moved from management consulting at McKinsey to Citicorp Venture Capital before establishing NTC Group in 1985. The Greenwich firm became a long-horizon acquirer and operator of smaller industrial businesses. Its holdings have included Stevens Aerospace, which Foley chaired for more than three decades, and Tenax Aerospace, where he remains chairman and majority owner.

His career also crossed into public service. Foley directed private-sector development for the Coalition Provisional Authority in Iraq, then represented the United States in Ireland during the late 2000s. He later ran twice for governor of Connecticut. Back in business, he continued to oversee Tenax's strategy, financing, acquisitions and contract decisions while NTC concentrated on aerospace, defence and specialist manufacturing.

uncertainties.detail: The exact full-name White House appointment, NTC and Tenax business chain, Connecticut geography and direct Odalisque comments resolve this owner as the investor and former ambassador. He is not Thomas Stephen Foley, the former House speaker and ambassador to Japan, nor Tom Foley Jr., whom NTC lists separately as a director.

The immutable record and a 2010 Connecticut report independently connect Foley to Odalisque, with Foley himself discussing its registration, storage and use. Because vessel details are transient and unrelated to the durable wealth biography, they support identity only and are excluded from both biographies.

NTC describes itself as an alternative to conventional private equity because it invests its own capital, manages no outside money and uses a buy-and-hold operator model. Finance & Investments still describes the original wealth-creation mechanism, but the active Private equity tag is not assigned because the firm's own description makes that narrower taxonomy label potentially misleading.

The 2026 SEC proxy identifies Foley as 53.2% owner and chairman of Tenax and details his direct operating decisions. A proposed merger with Air Industries remained subject to closing conditions during research, so the dossier does not treat the combined company, forecast results or anticipated chairmanship as completed.

The evidence shows that Foley founded NTC after professional roles at McKinsey and Citicorp Venture Capital, without inheriting the platform. It does not disclose the source of the first acquisition capital or enough family-financial background to distinguish an independent from advantaged start, so the broader Self-made label is used.

The existing identity-matched Wikipedia article gives 9 January 1952 and Evanston, Illinois. The year is independently consistent with the immutable 2020 age snapshot and contemporary Irish reporting; no second strong source reviewed stated the exact day or birthplace, so those proposals remain in the high rather than very-high confidence band.

No dedicated Forbes profile or identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website met the threshold. The existing Wikipedia link is retained, and the official NTC leadership page is proposed only as Company Website.

Only Aerospace and Ambassador are proposed. Both satisfy exact active catalogue contracts through long-term control and formal public office. Aviation would substantially duplicate the broader aerospace operating fact, while Private equity is withheld because NTC expressly distinguishes its own-capital model from conventional private-equity funds.
